purpose: Exact privileged Edge Function set intentionally deferred until executable source caller semantics are preserved or final cutover makes the independent target authoritative.

policy.caller_evidence_rule: Count only executable call paths such as cron.schedule/net.http_post, direct fetch, Supabase functions.invoke, or a dynamic dispatcher whose resolved target is proven. UI labels, health rows, registries, comments, scripts and string mentions are not callers by themselves.
policy.historical_vs_live_rule: A committed executable migration proves a historical caller definition, not that the corresponding job or trigger is currently active in the live Lovable source. Live activation remains unresolved until source database/runtime inventory is obtained.
policy.pre_cutover: Do not weaken authorization and do not add a new handler guard on main when an unobservable Lovable/platform caller could be broken.
policy.cutover: Every entry must receive an explicit caller trust boundary before Lovable-pause readiness can pass.
policy.forbidden_shortcut: A Supabase anon/publishable key or gateway verify_jwt alone is not privileged authorization.

functions.name: autonomous-accumulator
functions.evidence: supabase/migrations/20260420090029_26274051-0f0a-41da-8c7b-8efa9126bc13.sql contains an executable cron.schedule -> net.http_post call to /functions/v1/autonomous-accumulator using a legacy anon JWT. This proves a historical direct caller definition, not current live activation.
functions.cutover_requirement: Inventory the live/restored scheduler state. Keep restored jobs disabled, replace any required source-style caller with target invoke_aicis_edge_function + x-cron-secret, then enforce requireAdminOrTrustedWorker.

functions.name: gdelt-firehose
functions.evidence: Exact /functions/v1/gdelt-firehose and internal-dispatch searches found health/schema/manifest references but no committed executable scheduler, fetch, functions.invoke or proven dynamic-dispatch target. This does not prove the live Lovable source has no scheduler.
functions.cutover_requirement: Resolve the actual live scheduler/provider trigger and cadence, preserve it only in the audited target cutover phase, then enforce requireAdminOrTrustedWorker.

functions.name: graph-recovery-tick
functions.evidence: pipeline-watchdog reads pipeline_heartbeats.target_function and invokes the resolved function through invokeInternalFunction; migration 20260420015726_0867a83b-0520-487b-8bd8-cd24db27d7eb.sql seeds graph-recovery-tick as a target_function. invokeInternalFunction sends x-cron-secret. The external schedule that starts this path is not proven active in the live source.
functions.cutover_requirement: Preserve the proven x-cron-secret dynamic-worker path, resolve any additional live direct scheduler, then enforce requireAdminOrTrustedWorker only when callers are compatible.

functions.name: ingest-maritime-ais-telemetry
functions.evidence: The enterprise registry labels this connector as a webhook, but no code was found that executes job_metadata.function and no committed exact function URL, functions.invoke or proven dynamic dispatcher targets ingest-maritime-ais-telemetry. Registry presence is configuration, not caller evidence.
functions.cutover_requirement: Determine the actual AIS delivery mode. If push, require a dedicated webhook signature/HMAC secret with replay protection; if pull/internal, use trusted-worker auth. Never substitute anon JWT authorization.

functions.name: ingest-opensky-aviation-telemetry
functions.evidence: The enterprise registry references this Edge Function, but no code was found that executes job_metadata.function and no committed exact function URL, functions.invoke or proven dynamic dispatcher targets ingest-opensky-aviation-telemetry. The handler itself polls OpenSky.
functions.cutover_requirement: Resolve the live polling scheduler and provider rate/cadence constraints, preserve it only at audited target cutover, then enforce requireAdminOrTrustedWorker.

functions.name: lril-process
functions.evidence: Exact-name, exact function-URL, functions.invoke and cron.schedule searches found the worker, LRIL support schema/memory and audit references but no committed executable caller to lril-process. Related LRIL workers do not by themselves prove invocation of this function.
functions.cutover_requirement: Trace the live/restored LRIL scheduler or orchestration path, rebind any required caller to target trusted-worker invocation, then enforce requireAdminOrTrustedWorker.

functions.name: narrative-clustering

functions.cutover_requirement: Resolve the production trigger/cadence from live/restored runtime evidence, rebind any required target caller, then enforce requireAdminOrTrustedWorker.

functions.name: planetary-backfill
functions.evidence: Current graph-recovery-tick directly fetches /functions/v1/planetary-backfill with a service-role Bearer. pipeline-watchdog can also resolve planetary-backfill through target_function and invokeInternalFunction with x-cron-secret. Historical migrations 20260413114431_7dfd2577-1e0c-4c94-8ff9-49b773850234.sql and 20260413114900_c155eccf-ce46-44f7-bacc-40895b228609.sql define database HTTP wrappers posting to the Lovable source with a legacy anon JWT. Historical wrapper activation in the live source is unresolved.
functions.cutover_requirement: Keep historical source wrappers quarantined on target, preserve the current service-role and x-cron-secret trusted-worker paths or atomically rebind them, resolve live wrapper usage, then enforce requireAdminOrTrustedWorker.
